t: Semantic Clustering & the Rule of 7: Crafting an AI-Friendly Site Hierarchy
s: Transforms a 'content stew' into an AI-navigable site hierarchy using semantic clustering and the 'Rule of 7' branching strategy for efficient drill-down and balanced content discovery.
sub: Divisive Hierarchical Clustering for site navigation
